messages:
Priya: Quick sync we need alignment for the 'staggered-rollout-window' pilot. Goal: steady 1.5k rps @ ~180ms p95, handle bursts to 4k rps for up to 10m. Need prewarm strategy, reserved burst plan, KMS requirements, canary shape, and rollback triggers. cc @Ethan @Maya @Leo @Sam
Ethan: For predictable p95 I'd prefer reserving warm slots + KV prefix prefill. Autoscale too risky for initial pilot. How many nodes do we need as a buffer?
Maya: Runtime recommends 1.5x steady capacity for burst headroom and a 8-10 minute prewarm window. We'll warm top 50 prefixes + KV entries and run synthetic prompts during warmup. Need a fallback model id (quantized) and per-tenant canaries.
Leo: Infra can reserve a 2-node burst pool if you commit now. Scheduler needs 48h lead time. If KMS/HSM is required open onboarding ticket; rotation will need a scheduled window.
Priya: KMS required for pilot. I'll open the ticket today. SLA target for first 2 weeks: 99.9%.
Sam: Security ok with KMS + audit logs. Need a 30m threat-model review and an IaC PR for least-privilege key roles. Also confirm telemetry excludes PII before export.
Ethan: Rollout plan: tenant-scoped canary + percent ramp. Can we support explicit tenant pins and percent ramps? We should also document expected quality delta for fallback model.
Maya: Runtime supports both tenant pins and percent ramps. Example rollout config we'll add to the spec: ```json
{"canary":{"mode":"percent","start":2,"ramp_to":25,"step_mins":30},"fallback_model":"redwood-mini-q6","prefix_warm_list":["/search","/reply","/summarize"]}
```
Leo: I'll queue reservation request for a 2-node burst pool and set autoscale grace to 20m. ETA for reservation ticket: within 2h. I'll post the reservation id when approved.
Ethan: Suggested automated rollback triggers: sustained error_rate >0.5% for 5m OR p95 >420ms for 5m OR semantic top-5 match drop >6% -> rollback. Also an on-call alert threshold at p95 >350ms.
Maya: Agree. I'll add continuous evals against the synthetic prompt set every 5m and wire alerts. Metrics to track: gen p95, error rate, top-k semantic match, token-cost delta, and rollback flag.
Priya: Actions: Priya -> open KMS ticket (#TICKET-7902) + customer comms; Ethan -> add canary flags + doc fallback tradeoffs by Tue; Maya -> publish prefix warmlist + attach eval prompts; Leo -> submit reservation and post ID; Sam -> schedule threat-model within 48h and open IaC PR. No objections?
ops-bot: canary feature toggled in staging at 2024-07-21T01:45Z
Priya: Thanks  if no objections by EOD I'll lock scope and start tickets.
